Standalone exact enumeration matched all 126 finite controls; finite checks are not used as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The motivic gap is the source paper taking only ell=2,3 aggregate mean asymptotics, leaving every ell without a full limiting law and variance. This proves all ell>=2 at fixed ell and all positive-real moments, providing a complete probability profile with a natural ell-dependent rate; neither an arbitrary slice nor just coefficient replication.
